title: Industrial blue/white B2B packaging manufacturer marketing website with products, trust points, and contact form

requirements.text: Create a modern, professional, industrial and trustworthy blue/white website theme and apply it consistently across all sections (typography, spacing, buttons, section backgrounds, and icon style).

quotes: The website should look industrial, trustworthy, and business-oriented with blue and white color theme.

acceptanceCriteria: Site uses a consistent blue/white palette with an industrial/business visual style across all pages/sections
Primary and secondary button styles are consistent and accessible (contrast, hover/focus states)
Layout looks professional on desktop and mobile (no overlapping or clipped content)

requirements.text: Implement the marketing site structure with a clear navigation (header with links) and the following sections: Homepage (hero + intro + primary CTA), About Us, Products, Why Choose Us, and Contact. Support smooth in-page navigation to sections.

quotes: Include the following sections: Homepage ... About Us ... Products Section ... Why Choose Us ... Contact Section

acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation links scroll/jump to the correct section (Homepage, About, Products, Why Choose Us, Contact)
A footer is present with basic company contact details and quick links
All user-facing text is in English

requirements.text: Build the Homepage hero with a large banner, the exact tagline “Strong Packaging. Safe Delivery. Trusted Quality.”, a short company introduction, and a clearly visible “Contact Us” button that navigates to the Contact section.

quotes:
Big banner with tagline:
“Strong Packaging. Safe Delivery. Trusted Quality.”

acceptanceCriteria: Hero displays the tagline exactly as provided (same punctuation/capitalization)
A short intro paragraph is visible above the fold on desktop
Clicking “Contact Us” moves focus/scroll to the Contact section

requirements.text: Create an About Us section describing the company as reliable, quality-focused, and a bulk supplier for B2B clients, explicitly mentioning competitive pricing and timely delivery.

quotes: Describe the company as reliable, quality-focused, and bulk supplier for B2B clients
Mention competitive pricing and timely delivery

acceptanceCriteria: About Us copy includes: reliability, quality-focused approach, B2B bulk supply, competitive pricing, and timely delivery

requirements.text: Create a Products section that lists and briefly describes these product categories: Corrugated Boxes, Carton Packaging, Bubble Wrap, Packaging Rolls, Custom Printed Packaging.

quotes:
Products Section
Corrugated Boxes
Carton Packaging
Bubble Wrap
Packaging Rolls
Custom Printed Packaging

acceptanceCriteria: All five product categories are shown with clear titles
Each product has a short descriptive line suitable for B2B buyers
Products are presented in a responsive grid/list that works on mobile

requirements.text: Create a “Why Choose Us” section highlighting: Premium Quality Materials, Bulk Supply Capability, On-Time Delivery, Affordable Pricing.

quotes:
Why Choose Us
Premium Quality Materials
Bulk Supply Capability
On-Time Delivery
Affordable Pricing

acceptanceCriteria: All four value points are visible and visually emphasized (e.g., cards or bullet highlights)
Section remains readable and well-spaced on mobile

requirements.text: Create a Contact section that displays Phone: 7050223696, Email: p1204631@gmail.com, includes a simple contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Message), includes a WhatsApp contact button, and shows the call-to-action text “Contact us today for bulk orders and custom packaging solutions.”

quotes:
Contact Section
Phone: 7050223696
Email: p1204631@gmail.com
Simple contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Message)
WhatsApp contact button
Add call-to-action text: “Contact us today for bulk orders and custom packaging solutions.”

acceptanceCriteria: Phone number and email are displayed exactly as provided
CTA text is displayed exactly as provided (same punctuation/capitalization)
Contact form includes fields: Name, Phone, Email, Message, with basic validation and a clear submit button
WhatsApp button opens a WhatsApp chat using the phone number (e.g., wa.me link)

requirements.text: Implement backend support to accept contact form submissions and persist them in the canister so submissions are not lost on refresh. Provide a safe, minimal API to create a contact message and optionally list messages for future admin use.

quotes: Simple contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Message)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an update method to submit a contact message containing name, phone, email, and message
Submitted messages are stored persistently (survive canister calls and page reloads)
Backend validates that required fields are non-empty and returns an error for invalid submissions

requirements.text: Wire the frontend contact form to the backend submission API with user feedback (loading, success, and error states) and ensure form submission is fast and does not block the UI.

quotes: Simple contact form (Name, Phone, Email, Message)
The website should be mobile-friendly, fast-loading

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form shows a loading state and then a success message on completion
On success, form fields are cleared
On backend error, an error message is shown without losing the entered content

requirements.text: Ensure the site is mobile-friendly and fast-loading: responsive layouts, optimized images, and no unnecessary heavy assets. Maintain good accessibility for navigation and form controls.

quotes: The website should be mobile-friendly, fast-loading

acceptanceCriteria: All sections render properly on common breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)
Images are served in appropriate sizes and do not cause layout shift (dimensions reserved)
Interactive elements are keyboard accessible and have visible focus states

requirements.text: Add basic SEO optimizations for a single-page marketing site: meaningful page title, meta description, semantic headings (H1/H2), and Open Graph/Twitter meta tags appropriate for a packaging manufacturing company.
acceptanceCriteria: Document title and meta description are set to relevant business-focused content
Page uses a single clear H1 and logical H2s for sections
Open Graph and Twitter meta tags are present with consistent title/description

requirements.text: Add generated static image assets to support the industrial theme (hero banner, logo, and simple product category icons) and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve images via the backend).

quotes: The website should look industrial, trustworthy, and business-oriented with blue and white color theme.

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI
Hero section uses the generated hero banner image without noticeably degrading performance
Products section uses the generated product icons/illustrations consistently

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose those components instead.
Do not add third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is supported (not required for this build).
Do not use external databases or third-party email/SMS services for contact form delivery.
nonGoals: E-commerce checkout, pricing calculator, inventory management, or online ordering workflow
Admin dashboard for viewing contact submissions (backend may support listing for future use, but no UI is required unless explicitly requested)

required: Industrial packaging factory/warehouse hero banner, blue-and-white tones (hero-banner.dim_1920x800.png)
Simple modern logo mark for a packaging manufacturer, blue-and-white (logo.dim_512x512.png)
Custom printed packaging icon/illustration, minimal blue/white (product-custom-printed.dim_512x512.png)
